manual: local/S3 write inputs, byte validation, response-body deadlines, redaction and cleanup
bucket browser upload invocation, CSRF capture, resumable state and progress
deployment artifact/runtime provider bytes through digest verification and lease revalidation
contextual frozen interfaces and WebCrypto/Fetch byte ownership
scope.wholeSource: Pinned semantic analysis and complete release gate supplement these targeted reads; no independent line-by-line audit of every source file is claimed.

findings.title: Asynchronous writes and Blob buffering read changed caller inputs
findings.evidence: Local put copied bytes after asynchronous key lookup; local/S3 put read contentType after asynchronous work. Blob uploads read mutable options and resolve CSRF after file buffering. Inputs are now captured before the first await.

findings.title: Resumable clients accept invalid state or nonmatching progress
findings.evidence: Malformed chunk sizes and offsets permit invalid/repeated chunks; missing, regressing, fractional, skipped or NaN response offsets cause incorrect progress. Invalid intent state fails before PATCH; intermediate offsets must exactly match the accepted chunk end.

findings.title: S3 body failures escape stable errors and rejected metadata leaves an unread body
findings.evidence: A native loopback HTTP response sends valid headers but stalls its body: before the fix its deadline escapes as a raw fetch abort error. Body transport errors now return redacted 502 errors; deadlines return 504. Response release cancels unread bodies.

findings.title: Object stores coerce unsupported JavaScript values into bytes
findings.evidence: Strings, arrays and custom slice objects could become empty objects. Local/S3 stores now reject non-Uint8Array/non-ArrayBuffer values before provider or filesystem admission.

findings.title: Deployment provider bytes change after verification and before transfer
findings.evidence: Provider-owned buffers mutate during the required second lease authentication; SharedArrayBuffer views also fail WebCrypto validation before the fix. The coordinator copies bounded bytes, hashes the copy and sends the same copy after authenticating the lease again.

findings.title: Rejected diagnostics escape bucket/coordinator/agent failure containment
findings.evidence: Observers throwing synchronously or rejecting asynchronously cannot replace safe coordinator/bucket errors or terminate agent polling/recovery.

findings.title: Frozen storage and runner interfaces lose contextual types
findings.evidence: Explicit freeze interface types and owned Fetch/WebCrypto buffers remove 83 diagnostics: buckets 34, object storage 15 and runner 34. No new diagnostics or baseline allowances.

initialStorageRunner.scope: 14 isolated regressions against the base build: six progress offsets, local/S3 input snapshots, S3 body timeout/cleanup and four artifact/runtime transfer cases.

correctedBucketObserver.scope: One correctly configured app-owned bucket regression with only compiled bucket observer containment reverted; the current build was restored immediately.

additionalObserversAndInputs.scope: Non-byte input and synchronous/asynchronous coordinator observer regressions are genuine (three). Exclude the fourth failure: its bucket fixture lacked app ownership and failed authorization before reaching its observer.

blobAndIntent.scope: Blob capture and four invalid intent states fail before these fixes; the beyond-length offset control already failed closed and passes.

compatibility.behavior: Valid byte writes and resumable uploads retain their contracts; invalid JavaScript values, malformed resumable state and nonmatching progress fail closed with existing errors. Provider buffers incur one bounded copy before verification/transfer. Lease, node credential, ownership, quota and digest checks remain required.

remaining.productionHost: Current Railway host denies required Linux namespaces; no deployment certification or isolation bypass performed.
remaining.privilegedTests: XFS/Docker certification requires an explicitly disposable compatible host.
remaining.otherObservers: This batch contains bucket/coordinator/runner-agent observers; other modules remain separate review targets.
remaining.transferMemory: Artifact/runtime snapshots allocate one additional bounded byte buffer. Shared memory must still be coordinated by the provider during copying; no atomic cross-thread snapshot is claimed.
